newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Foreign investment in Morocco falls 3.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Morocco falls 3.9 pct.

text.p: Foreign investments in Morocco fell 3.9 percent to 3.3 billion dirhams ($354 million) in the 11 months to November 1996 from 3.4 billion dirhams in the same 1995 period, Morocco's trade regulatory body said on Monday.
The Office des Changes said the drop was attributed mainly to a fall in loans which stood at 209.4 million dirhams from 640 million in the comparative 1995 period.

Main increases were in portfolio investments which rose 39.9 percent to 1.2 billion dirhams from 891.6 million, and direct investments which went up 3 percent to 1.76 billion from 1.71 billion. ($=9.43 dinars)
